items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: That's where I first saw the legendary T-Bone Walker doing his trip down there.

ctx.x: And those guys, they used to really live it up. Like, nightclub owners used to do things that they don't do now. They'd go and patronize each other. The guy would come in and he'd set up the whole bar. Which is nothing but promotion! -- you know. And they really-really-really lived it up.
